abstract: Best practices for vite-plugin-hellajs, the thin Vite wrapper around hellajs-compiler: registering the viteHellaJS() default export in the plugins array, the single target option (unset it resolves per build environment: server builds emit ast HellaNode for @hellajs/ssr, client builds emit dom @hellajs/dom/runtime construction), eager option validation at construction, bare-specifier resolution of @hellajs/* packages with no aliasing, declaring the runtime packages compiled output imports, and keeping one JSX pipeline per config. Every rule is grounded in the wrapper source and the example configs.
